title: Bạn có thể gửi cho tôi vị trí của bạn?
englishTitle: Can you send me your location?
pronunciation: Ban co the gui cho toi vi tri cua ban
summary: For asking a driver, host, shop, friend, or helper to send their exact location to your phone.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask while the chat, map, pickup, or address problem is still open on your screen.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the messaging app or map. The answer may be a pin, address, nearby landmark, or shared location.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể gửi cho tôi vị trí của bạn?
phrases.english: Can you send me your location?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the gui cho toi vi tri cua ban

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể asks can you; gửi cho tôi means send me; vị trí của bạn means your location.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bạn có thể gửi cho tôi vị trí của bạn?
breakdown.english: Can you send me your location?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wi-Fi-password and SIM-card cards help if the location issue is really a connectivity issue.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good for ride pickups, hotel meetups, shops, tours, deliveries, and friends when the written address is not enough.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If sharing a live location feels too much, ask for a nearby landmark or typed address instead.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Dead-battery, charger, charge-here, Wi-Fi, and SIM cards cover nearby phone problems.
